name: comms
description: Comms Desk. Adaptive writing-voice plugin (renamed from writing-style, 2026-09-15; renamed from voice, 2026-09-15). Learns your voice over time from real edits. Draft-first workflow for emails, posts, docs — including the weekly roundup post via /post, which drafts from research's staged candidates using the post-assembler agent. Detects patterns across 2+ recurrences before committing style-guide updates. Companion to cortex's /setup-voice — one-time capture + continuous learning. Research finds; Comms Desk writes.
